name: motion-ease-expo-scale
title: ExpoScaleEase
description: Phóng từ 1 lên 8 lần theo hàm mũ để mỗi lần gấp đôi tốn cùng thời gian, trông đều tốc thay vì chậm đầu nhanh cuối.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-expo-scale, written here): Zoom scale 1 → 8 over 1800 ms interpolated in log space: scale(p) = start × (end / start)^p, p linear or eased, so every doubling takes the same time; as a 0→1 ease for a scale tween 1→8: e(p) = (8^p − 1) / 7. Proposed alias expoScale(start, end[, inner ease]). Site demo: linear vs exponential zoom side by side on a small square. Params: duration (1.8 s) · from (1) · to (8) · ease trong (none). Scale interpolated in log space, so every doubling takes the same time; as a 0-1 ease for a 1 → 8 scale: (8^p − 1) / 7.
